messages:
Olivia Ward: Hey all — Olivia here, starting my first week in Product. trying to run `kubectl get pods` but kubectl says "no configuration has been provided". I merged the quickstart kubeconfig but i don't see any contexts. Need access to namespace `sandbox-olivia` and to port-forward a service for local tests. who should I ping?

onboard-bot: Hi Olivia! Please open the Kube access onboarding form so infra can track approvals: https://go.redwood.internal/onboard-kube. If you've already submitted, reply here with the request ID.

devex: welcome! quick wins: 1) check `echo $KUBECONFIG` and `kubectl config view --minify --raw | head -n 5` 2) sometimes macOS keychain/macos-specific merges break — did you follow the mac quickstart?

Olivia Ward: echo $KUBECONFIG -> /Users/olivia/.kube/config:/tmp/redwood-kube
kubectl config view --minify --raw | head -n 3 ->
```
apiVersion: v1
clusters: []
contexts: []
```

eng-infra: thanks — looks like your local config isn't picking up the org contexts. Please paste your company email and the onboarding request ID and we'll provision a service-account kubeconfig for `sandbox-olivia`. For port-forwarding we usually grant `edit` in the sandbox ns. ETA ~30–45m once request is created.

sre-kate: fyi @eng-infra — for sandbox namespaces we allow edit for new-hires group; for anything touching secrets or prod-sim we require owner approval.

onboard-bot: Request created: KUBE-REQ-2345 — approvers: eng-infra, sre. Link: https://go.redwood.internal/requests/KUBE-REQ-2345

eng-infra: done — created a service-account kubeconfig for Olivia (KUBE-REQ-2345). Bound group `new-hires-2026` and the SA to role `edit` in namespace `sandbox-olivia`. kubeconfig stored in Vault: https://vault.redwood/internal/kubeconfigs/KUBE-REQ-2345 (expires in 7d). Try:
```
export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/olivia-kube
kubectl get pods -n sandbox-olivia
kubectl port-forward -n sandbox-olivia svc/my-service 8080:80
```
If that doesn't work paste the error here and we'll iterate.

Olivia Ward: confirmed — `kubectl get pods -n sandbox-olivia` lists pods and port-forward to localhost:8080 works. Really appreciate the quick help!

devex: :tada: welcome aboard. i'll add a note to the quickstart about merging multiple kubeconfigs (mac edge cases). let us know if you need any other namespaces or CI access.
__notes: Generated Slack thread for new-hire kube onboarding. All messages are a single continuous string as required.
